name: Zaferan
headline: Zaferan
description: A source of curcumin, an extract from the root of the tropical plant turmeric. Curcumin helps reduce symptoms of indigestion, supports the work of the liver and gallbladder and eases inflammatory joint conditions.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
